# NXExtract 1.1.0

First standalone MIT release of the universal Android-data extractor and bake
framework.

## Highlights

- content-driven APK, loose-split, APKM, APKS, XAPK, companion archive, OBB
  and loose-file discovery;
- external filenames never identify a game;
- ABI-neutral recipes with `elf_machine: "{abi}"`;
- resumable same-filesystem staging and optional bake checkpoints;
- full validation, journaled publication, rollback and crash recovery;
- adaptive SDL2 UI verified with visible `mali` and `KMSDRM` backends;
- Python 3.7+ standard-library core;
- AArch64 UI requiring only GLIBC 2.17, below the enforced GLIBC 2.30 ceiling.

The `nxextract-ui-aarch64` release asset has SHA-256:

```text
046afb583f5a211c946495e639409f81d9cfec706788eeccb7924b0e8e5a50b6
```

No APK, OBB, game library, game asset or other proprietary data is included.
